title: HoldFast - Strategy/RPG/Tower defence
author: Tds2727
selftext:
Been vibe coding a tower defence game for the last few weeks and it's finally at the point where I'm not embarrassed to share it lol

It's called Holdfast. You defend a keep from skeletons coming from every side, and you've got three heroes you dress up with loot. The gear actually shows on them, which took way longer to get working than I expected.

It's free on itch and runs in the browser, phone or PC:

https://innovatorsplayground.itch.io/holdfast

Happy to answer anything about how I built it. And if you play it, tell me where you got bored, that's the stuff I can't see myself.
